title: A warm Black Friday, parade weekend in Hollywood and rain on the way
dek: Low 80s today before back-to-back storms next week, the Hollywood Christmas Parade closes streets Sunday, USC plays UCLA at the Rose Bowl, and LAUSD switches off Google's AI summaries.

items.h: Low 80s for Black Friday, then back-to-back storms next week
items.t: Friday brought sunshine and highs around 83 in the basin and the valleys, with gusty winds through the canyons. The weekend cools a bit. A light storm is expected Monday, then a stronger one Tuesday into Wednesday that could bring 2 to 4 inches of rain depending on location, plus mountain snow. Clear gutters and check your drains before Tuesday.

items.h: King tides ease and the Manhattan Beach Pier is open again
items.t: The Manhattan Beach Pier reopened Thursday afternoon after high surf forced it closed. A coastal flood advisory for the LA County coast ran until noon Friday, and a high surf advisory stays in effect until 9 p.m. Saturday, so expect strong currents if you head to the sand this weekend.

items.h: The Hollywood Christmas Parade rolls Sunday at 6 p.m.
items.t: The 94th parade runs a loop of Hollywood and Sunset boulevards on Sunday, Nov. 29, with pre-show entertainment at 5:30 p.m. Hollywood Boulevard closes at La Brea Avenue starting at 6 a.m., and Sunset closes between La Brea and Highland in the afternoon. Reserved grandstand seats are sold out, but curbside viewing is free along much of the route east of Highland. Metro is the easy way in.

items.h: USC and UCLA close the regular season at the Rose Bowl Saturday
items.t: UCLA hosts crosstown rival USC in Pasadena on Saturday, Nov. 28, to end the 2026 regular season. USC won last year's meeting 29-10 at the Coliseum.

items.h: Last weekend for the LA Auto Show downtown
items.t: The LA Auto Show wraps up its 10-day run at the Convention Center on Sunday, Nov. 29. Expect new hybrids and EVs, test drives and a classic car section.

items.h: LAUSD turns off Google's AI summaries on student devices
items.t: Los Angeles Unified has disabled Google's AI Overview in searches on school-issued devices, calling the step temporary while it reviews student safeguards. The move comes as Google has said schools that block its AI features could lose access to search, and some districts are weighing other search providers.

items.h: A new Brentwood estate sells for $39 million
items.t: A newly built home at 401 N. Tigertail Road in Brentwood sold for $39 million, The Real Deal reported this week. It first shopped off market at $75 million and was later listed at $65 million.

items.h: Black Friday crowds start the night before
items.t: Shoppers headed to Citadel Outlets in Commerce straight from Thanksgiving dinner for its overnight sale, with discounts of up to 70% and the doors open until 11 p.m. Friday. Saturday is Small Business Saturday, a good day to shop the neighborhood stores near you.
